material_findings.title: K17 CTF 2026 shortened to 24 hours
material_findings.summary: The K17 CTF organizer-primary site now confirms a 24-hour online event from September 11, 2026 at 10:00 UTC through September 12 at 10:00 UTC. CTFtime's event shell still shows the former September 13 end date but explicitly notes that the competition was shortened to 24 hours.
material_findings.eligibility_and_cost: Organizer says participation is open to everyone, teams may be any size, solo play is allowed, and registration is available through the event scoreboard. No entry fee is stated on the organizer page fetched in this pass.
material_findings.scope_and_authorization: This finding authorizes nothing beyond participation under the final event rules. If the suite participates, preserve the organizer/scoreboard rules and interact only with event-provided challenge infrastructure.
material_findings.prize_evidence: CTFtime lists first place as one IDA Pro Essential license. The organizer page fetched in this pass names Hex-Rays among sponsors but does not expose prize terms, so the prize remains discovery-level rather than organizer-verified.
material_findings.recommended_action: If selecting a near-term practice CTF before PwnSec, use the organizer-primary Sep. 11 10:00 -> Sep. 12 10:00 UTC window. Re-open and preserve final rules immediately before participation; do not rely on the stale CTFtime headline end date.
